name: Formula Legends: Late 2020’s Season Pack
summary:
The Late 2020’s (2026) Season Pack brings present-day racing to Formula Legends.

This new DLC introduces 8 new teams, each with 2 drivers and custom helmets, along with 2 new liveries per team, a new championship, updated next-generation season rules, and a brand-new track — all fully integrated into Story Mode.

Compete in a new championship featuring modernized racing rules that reflect the latest innovations and standards in professional motorsport. Every decision matters, as strategy, skill, and precision define the outcome. Race on the Azerbaijan track, a contemporary circuit that challenges timing, overtaking, and tactical thinking.

With this DLC, the Late 2020’s (2026) Season Pack delivers a complete, authentic and engaging present-day racing experience — perfect for fans of modern motorsport and Story Mode enthusiasts alike.

This DLC includes:

8 new teams

16 new drivers with unique helmets

16 new liveries (2 per team)

1 new Story Mode championship

Updated next-generation (2026) season rules

1 new track: Azerbaijan
